Belo-crni (The White-Blacks) | ground = [[Čukarički Stadium]] | capacity = 4,070 | league = [[Serbian SuperLiga]] | season = [[2025–26 Serbian SuperLiga|2025–26]] | position = Serbian SuperLiga, 8th of 16 | current = 2025–26 FK Čukarički season | pattern_la1 = _adidastirocm25w | pattern_b1 = _adidastirocm25w | pattern_ra1 = _adidastirocm25w | pattern_sh1 = _adidastirocm25w | pattern_so1 = _color 3 stripes black | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _adidastirocm25b | pattern_b2 = _adidastirocm25b | pattern_ra2 = _adidastirocm25b | pattern_sh2 = _adidastirocm25b | pattern_so2 = _color 3 stripes white | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 }} '''Fudbalski klub Čukarički''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|Фудбалски клуб Чукарички}}) is a Serbian professional [[Football team|football club]] from [[Belgrade]], more precisely from the [[Čukarica]] municipality, that currently plays in the [[Serbian SuperLiga]], the top tier of [[Serbian football league system|Serbian football]]. Founded in 1926, the club spent the first years of its existence in the amateur field.Official club site of Čukarički:[http://www.fkcukaricki.rs/klub/istorijat Istorijat kluba] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150704034437/http://www.fkcukaricki.rs/klub/istorijat |date=4 July 2015 }} In the days of [[Yugoslavia]], Čukarički played predominantly in the lower divisions of the country. The first notable achievements for the club were in the seasons of 1971–72, when they first reached the [[Yugoslav Second League]], and 1993–94, when they reached, for the first time ever in the club's history, the national top tier of football, the [[Yugoslav First League]], the first tier in the newly created [[Serbia and Montenegro]]. They played for the first time in the club's history on the European stage in the UEFA Intertoto Cup [[1996 UEFA Intertoto Cup|1996]] and the UEFA Intertoto Cup [[1997 UEFA Intertoto Cup|1997]] On 17 April 2012, the club was bought by Dragan Obradović, the owner of the Serbian construction and wholesale company ADOC.[http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/cukaricka-bajka-od-rusevina-do-jedinog-srpskog-kluba-bez-dugovanja] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130617051639/http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/cukaricka-bajka-od-rusevina-do-jedinog-srpskog-kluba-bez-dugovanja|date=17 June 2013}} Mozzart Sport (Serbian): ČUKARIČKA BAJKA: Od ruševina do jedinog srpskog kluba bez dugovanja – 15 June 2013[[Politika]]:[http://www.politika.rs/rubrike/Sport/fudbal/Uz-rame-prvaku-s-platama-od-200-do-2_000-evra.lt.html Posle privatizacije Čukarički uz rame prvaku] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140415123924/http://www.politika.rs/rubrike/Sport/fudbal/Uz-rame-prvaku-s-platama-od-200-do-2_000-evra.lt.html |date=15 April 2014 }} Since then Čukarički is the first ever professional football club in Serbia to have been [[Privatization|privatized]], and is also one of the first clubs in [[Southeast Europe]] which were ever bought. Since being bought the club has become one of the most stable and organised clubs in Serbian football and has competed in the [[UEFA Europa League|Europa League]] on four occasions since 2014.{{cite web | url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/history/clubs/60570--cukaricki/ | title=Čukarički | History }} The club won the [[2014–15 Serbian Cup]]. Their highest league finish has been third, which they've achieved four times, in [[2014–15 Serbian SuperLiga|2014–15]], [[2015–16 Serbian SuperLiga|2015–16]], [[2020–21 Serbian SuperLiga|2020–21]] and [[2021–22 Serbian SuperLiga|2021–22]]."}}
